messages.content: Put the rental plan and the split-hotel plan side by side now. I need the complete lodging and car numbers, not just nightly rates, and confirm that each place actually sleeps the three of us.

I have both structures using the same first two stops: Friday, July 10 at the Portland airport hotel, then Saturday, July 11 at an Ogunquit inn. After that, Plan A moves to the seven-night beach rental from July 12-19. Plan B stays in an Ogunquit hotel for four nights, July 12-16, then uses a three-night suite farther north from July 16-19. I’ll include taxes, mandatory fees, deposits, parking, and the nine-day rental-car charge.
Start with the rooms. I do not want a listing that technically allows three people but only has one real bed.

The Portland airport hotel has two queen beds and a stated maximum occupancy of four. The one-night Ogunquit inn room also has two queen beds and permits four. In Plan A, the rental has two enclosed bedrooms: one king bed in the first and two twin beds in the second, with a maximum occupancy of four. In Plan B, the four-night Ogunquit room has two queen beds. The northern suite has one king bedroom plus a queen-size sofa bed in the separate living room; the property has confirmed that the sofa bed may be used by the third registered guest at no added charge.
Good. Give me Plan A all the way through, including what is due and when it stops being refundable.

The Portland airport night is $246.00 including tax, payable at the hotel and cancellable without charge through 6:00 p.m. local time on July 9. The Saturday Ogunquit inn is $312.84 including tax, also payable at the property, with free cancellation through 11:59 p.m. on July 8. The seven-night rental totals $4,799.54: $3,745.00 rent, $245.00 cleaning, $431.00 service fee, and $378.54 lodging tax. It requires $2,879.72 at booking, and that first payment is nonrefundable. The remaining $1,919.82 is charged May 12; after that date the entire rental amount is nonrefundable. Total lodging for Plan A is $5,358.38.
And parking at the rental? The listing language was vague.

The host confirmed one off-street parking space, limited to one standard passenger vehicle. There is no second space and no guaranteed overnight street parking. That works with a single rental car, but any visitor bringing another vehicle would need separate municipal parking. Parking is included at the Portland airport hotel and the Saturday Ogunquit inn.
Now the split plan. Show each property separately.

The shared Portland and Saturday Ogunquit nights remain $246.00 and $312.84. The four-night Ogunquit hotel stay totals $1,786.20, including room charges, tax, and its mandatory destination fee. It takes a $446.55 first-night deposit at booking; that deposit is refundable if cancelled by 6:00 p.m. on May 30. The rest is paid at checkout. Self-parking is $25 per night, so add $100.00 for four nights. The three-night northern suite totals $2,064.78 including tax and its property fee. A $688.26 deposit is charged at booking, refundable through April 30. The remaining $1,376.52 is charged May 31. Cancellation from May 1 through June 15 forfeits the deposit; after June 15 the full stay is nonrefundable. Parking there is included.
So what is the actual lodging total on that one with the hotel parking included?

Plan B lodging is $4,409.82 before parking: $246.00 Portland, $312.84 for Saturday in Ogunquit, $1,786.20 for the four-night hotel, and $2,064.78 for the suite. Adding $100.00 hotel parking makes the complete lodging-and-parking total $4,509.82.
That makes it almost a thousand less than the rental, correct?
Before accounting for Plan B’s paid parking, the rental structure is $948.56 more. With the $100 parking charge included in Plan B, Plan A is $848.56 more: $5,358.38 versus $4,509.82.
Add the car. We pick it up Saturday morning and return it before the Sunday flight, so make sure the quote covers the extra hours.

The midsize SUV quote runs from 8:30 a.m. Saturday, July 11 through 11:00 a.m. Sunday, July 19. That is eight days and two and a half hours, billed as nine rental days. The total is $855.36: $684.00 base rate and $171.36 in taxes and facility fees. It is pay-at-pickup and can be cancelled without a fee before pickup. Fuel, tolls, optional coverage, and any additional-driver charge are excluded. The vehicle seats five and its listed cargo capacity is sufficient for three standard checked bags.
Daniel will drive too. Is he already covered as my spouse, or is that another charge?

At this Maine location, a spouse is an authorized additional driver at no charge if both drivers meet the license and age requirements and are present at pickup. Daniel should bring his driver’s license and be added to the agreement. The quoted $855.36 therefore does not change.
Give me the combined totals, including the flights we already selected and the checked bags.

The three fares and six checked-bag charges are $1,428.00. Plan A totals $7,641.74: $1,428.00 air and bags, $5,358.38 lodging, and $855.36 car. Plan B totals $6,793.18: $1,428.00 air and bags, $4,509.82 lodging and parking, and $855.36 car. Both remain estimates until booked, and neither includes fuel, tolls, meals, or optional rental coverage.
Before I choose, walk me through Saturday. We land late Friday, and I do not want the car pickup to erase the Portland morning.

Friday’s flight reaches PWM at 10:52 p.m.; after baggage claim, the airport-hotel shuttle should put you at the hotel around 11:35 p.m. to midnight. Saturday, take the shuttle back for the 8:30 a.m. rental appointment and expect to leave the lot around 9:00. The drive into central Portland is about 15-20 minutes. If you park by 9:25, you can spend roughly three hours there, leave around 12:30, and drive 45-60 minutes to Ogunquit. That puts you at the inn around 1:15-1:30 p.m.; if the room is not ready, the inn will hold luggage and the included parking space is available from 1:00 p.m.
And Sunday from the northern suite? I want a real cushion for the 1:25 nonstop, not an optimistic drive time.

Allow 1 hour 35 minutes to 1 hour 55 minutes from the suite to PWM in normal Sunday traffic, plus 10 minutes for fuel and 20-30 minutes for return inspection and the walk or shuttle to the terminal. Leaving the suite at 8:45 a.m. targets the rental return around 10:40-10:50 and the terminal around 11:00-11:15. That leaves about 2 hours 10 minutes to 2 hours 25 minutes before the 1:25 p.m. departure. I would treat 9:00 a.m. as the latest sensible departure; the rental is currently quoted through 11:00 a.m.

The split plan is the one to investigate. The lower total and later refund exposure outweigh moving once more. Do not reserve any of it yet. I want the next pass to verify the suite sofa-bed dimensions, whether the hotel destination fee includes anything useful, and whether the northbound move on Thursday creates a bad driving day.

Plan B is now the working coastal itinerary, still entirely unbooked. Its current complete total is $6,793.18, including the selected flights and bags, all nine lodging nights, four nights of hotel parking, and the nine-day rental-car charge. I’ll investigate the northern suite’s exact sofa-bed dimensions, the four-night hotel’s destination-fee inclusions, and Thursday’s Ogunquit-to-suite route and timing before any reservation is made. Plan A remains a comparison only at $7,641.74.
